Interface SceneController

All Superinterfaces:
ViewController
All Known Implementing Classes:
BoardViewController, LobbyViewController, NetworkSetupViewController, NickViewController, SplashViewController, TotemPickViewController, WaitingViewController, WinnerViewController
public interface SceneController extends ViewController
Contract for screen-level controllers managed by SceneRouter. Every controller that SceneRouter loads must supply a root pane (used for toast overlays and scene swaps) and accept a router binding.
